facts.statement: When Wootmoot's latest band does not show up, talking to him asks the player to step in and take the band's place on stage.
facts.quote: If you talk to Wootmoot he'll ask you to step up and take their place.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?: Meet Wootmoot
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms news blurb introducing Wootmoot, who runs the band stage on the main road of the town Wugachug and hires the bands. When his latest band fails to show, players can talk to him and take the band's place to get the party started. The page gives no exact post date (only 'posted 2 weeks, 6 days ago' relative to the 2010-01-25 capture).
